Request: Disable the password for the `service' user
Initial states: Both: service user exists. baseline: unlocked password hash; adversarial: locked password hash.
Playbook:
---
- name: Candidate playbook
  hosts: all
  become: true
  tasks:
  - name: Update /etc/shadow to disable password for 'service' user
    lineinfile:
      path: /etc/shadow
      regexp: '^service:'
      line: 'service:!!:1801:$6$65541a2e0168$c52Xj37iC9lU61N9z108:1801:0:99999999:7:::'
      backrefs: yes
    become: yes
